desc: Write a function to read input and parse N, A, B.
Separate A into `a_fixed` (non-negative) and count `na` (number of -1s).
Separate B into `b_fixed` (non-negative) and count `nb` (number of -1s).
Calculate `k_min = max(0, len(a_fixed) - nb, len(b_fixed) - na)`.
If `k_min > min(len(a_fixed), len(b_fixed))`, print "No" and exit.
Generate all candidate S values from `a[i] + b[j]` for all i, j.
For each candidate S, count how many pairs (a, b) with a+b=S exist. Use a frequency map or two-pointer/sorting approach for efficiency.
For each candidate S, verify that all unmatched fixed A's are <= S and all unmatched fixed B's are <= S.
If any candidate S satisfies all conditions, print "Yes" and exit.
If no candidate S works, print "No".
